title: Long artist names in capitals
statementMd:
Show each artist name in upper case along with its length in characters, for artists whose name is longer than 12 characters.

Expected columns: `name`, `chars`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT UPPER(name) AS name, LENGTH(name) AS chars FROM artists WHERE LENGTH(name) > 12;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
